products.name: iPhone 15 Pro
products.short: Titanium design, A17 Pro chip and a pro camera system with 5x telephoto zoom.
products.details:
iPhone 15 Pro is the first iPhone with an aerospace-grade titanium design, making it the lightest Pro model ever. The A17 Pro chip delivers a huge leap in GPU performance, enabling console-quality gaming right on your phone.

The pro camera system features a 48MP main camera that captures stunning detail, a new 5x telephoto camera on the Pro Max, and next-generation portraits with focus and depth control. The customizable Action button gives quick access to your favourite feature.

With USB‑C supporting USB 3 speeds, all‑day battery life and iOS, iPhone 15 Pro is built to last and designed to impress.

products.name: MacBook Air M2
products.short: Strikingly thin design with the M2 chip, 13.6" Liquid Retina display and 18h battery.
products.details:
Redesigned around the next-generation M2 chip, MacBook Air is strikingly thin and brings exceptional speed and power efficiency within its durable all‑aluminium enclosure.

The 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display supports one billion colours, and the 1080p FaceTime HD camera, four-speaker sound system and three-mic array make every call look and sound great.

With up to 18 hours of battery life and a fanless design, it stays silent no matter how hard you work.

products.name: AirPods Pro (2nd gen)
products.short: Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio and personalised spatial audio.
products.details:
AirPods Pro feature up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation, plus Adaptive Transparency and Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for immersive sound.

The H2 chip powers smarter noise cancellation and three-dimensional sound. Touch control lets you swipe to adjust volume, and the MagSafe charging case now has a speaker and lanyard loop.

products.name: Galaxy Watch 6
products.short: Advanced sleep coaching, heart monitoring and a larger, brighter display.
products.details:
Galaxy Watch6 helps you understand your body with advanced health insights. Sleep coaching, body composition, heart rhythm notifications and personalised heart rate zones keep you on track.

The display is 20% larger with slimmer bezels, and the sapphire crystal glass is built to withstand daily life.

products.name: Sony WH‑1000XM5
products.short: Industry-leading noise cancelling headphones with 30 hours battery.
products.details:
The WH-1000XM5 rewrites the rules for distraction-free listening. Two processors control eight microphones for unprecedented noise cancelling, and Auto NC Optimizer adjusts automatically to your environment.

A specially designed 30mm driver unit delivers natural, rich sound, and crystal clear hands-free calling uses precise voice pickup technology.

products.name: Xbox Wireless Controller
products.short: Hybrid D-pad, textured grip and Bluetooth for Xbox, PC and mobile.
products.details:
Experience the modernised design of the Xbox Wireless Controller, featuring sculpted surfaces and refined geometry for enhanced comfort during gameplay.

Stay on target with textured grip on the triggers, bumpers and back case, and a hybrid D-pad for accurate, yet familiar input.

products.name: Galaxy S24 Ultra
products.short: Galaxy AI, titanium frame, 200MP camera and built-in S Pen.
products.details:
Welcome to the era of mobile AI. With Galaxy S24 Ultra you can unleash whole new levels of creativity, productivity and possibility, starting with the most important device in your life.

The 200MP camera with ProVisual Engine captures incredible detail in any light, while the titanium frame and Corning Gorilla Armor keep it protected.

products.name: iPad Pro 11"
products.short: Ultra Retina XDR display, M4 chip and Apple Pencil Pro support.
products.details:
The thinnest Apple product ever, iPad Pro features the breakthrough Ultra Retina XDR display and the outrageous performance of the M4 chip.

With Apple Pencil Pro and the Magic Keyboard, it becomes the ultimate creative and productivity machine.

products.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
products.short: The most rugged and capable Apple Watch, with a 3000-nit display.
products.details:
Apple Watch Ultra 2 is designed for endurance, exploration and adventure. A 49mm titanium case, precision dual-frequency GPS and up to 36 hours of battery life.

The brightest Apple display ever reaches 3000 nits, and the new double tap gesture lets you control your watch without touching the screen.

products.name: Dell XPS 13
products.short: Premium ultrabook with InfinityEdge display and Intel Core Ultra.
products.details:
The XPS 13 is precision-crafted from machined aluminium with a stunning edge-to-edge InfinityEdge display.

Powered by Intel Core Ultra processors with built-in AI acceleration, it delivers smooth performance and long battery life in an incredibly compact form.

products.name: 65W GaN Charger Kit
products.short: 3-port fast charger with braided USB‑C cable for phone and laptop.
products.details:
Charge your laptop, phone and earbuds simultaneously with this compact 65W GaN charger. Advanced gallium nitride technology keeps it small and cool.

Includes a durable braided 1.5m USB‑C to USB‑C cable.

products.name: DualSense Controller
products.short: Haptic feedback, adaptive triggers and built-in microphone.
products.details:
Discover a deeper gaming experience with the innovative PS5 controller, featuring haptic feedback and dynamic trigger effects.

A built-in microphone and headset jack let you chat with friends, while the Create button lets you capture and share your best moments.
